title: Agent Name Collision Attacks in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent hosts turn remote Agent Cards into local agents, tools, workflow targets, and broker routes. A2A defines the card's name as human-readable metadata, not as a stable identity, and specifies no collision semantics. The security failure begins when a host nevertheless uses that remote name as a local routing identifier.
